startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Page or homepage URLs to audit. For a whole site, pass the homepage and enable sitemap discovery.

sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs
sitemapUrls.description: Optional sitemap.xml or sitemap index URLs. If empty, the actor tries robots.txt and /sitemap.xml.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on HTML pages fetched and charged in this run.

followSitemap.title: Discover URLs from sitemap
followSitemap.description: Parse sitemap.xml (and indexes) and audit listed URLs up to the page cap.

followInternalLinks.title: Follow internal links
followInternalLinks.description: If fewer than max pages came from the input and sitemap, crawl same-host links to fill the cap.

checkBrokenLinks.title: Check broken links
checkBrokenLinks.description: HEAD/GET unique links found on each page (capped per page) and record 4xx/5xx targets.

maxLinksPerPage.title: Max links to check per page
maxLinksPerPage.description: Cap on outgoing links verified on each page when broken-link checks are on.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests (keep modest to be polite).
